name: Improved Pathfinding
body:
Your ability to find paths in even the wildest of regions is unmatched.

Prerequisite(s): Survival 5 ranks, 4th-level chronicler

Benefit: The bonus granted by your pathfinding ability to Survival checks made to avoid getting lost and to Intelligence checks made to escape a maze spell increases by +1 per 2 levels of chronicler you possess. In addition, you can choose to use the “highway” overland movement modifier instead of “road or trail” even when in trackless terrain, whether on foot or mounted, at no penalty. However, the DC of the Survival check to extend this benefit to others is 20, and you can only extend it to one companion per two class levels.
